walkthroughs.body_html:
Innovation & Design — a core area of Design Technology.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Innovation & Design brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Innovation & Design.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between ductility and malleability?
options: They mean exactly the same thing.
Stain is permanent, varnish always peels off.
Ductility is for metals, malleability is for plastics.
Ductility is being drawn into wires; malleability is being hammered into sheets.
